description: Learn how to offload resource file delivery to an external CDN, reducing server bandwidth and speeding up client downloads.

plainText: By default, clients download every file listed in a resource's file array directly from the dedicated server. This includes CEF UI assets, .archive / .xl packs, and tweak files. For servers with many players or large custom assets, this can saturate the server's upload bandwidth and slow down connection times. A resource CDN lets you host those files on an external HTTP server (or a traditional CDN provider) so that clients fetch them from a fast, dedicated download endpoint instead of the game

title: CDN
plainText: Core Files The built-in cybermpcore resource includes core files located in cybermpcore/files/ that are configured via the core.files setting. These files must be streamed to clients for proper connection. When packaging files for CDN via --justpack, ensure these files are packed and uploaded to your CDN. See the [[core] section](/reference/server/configuration) of the server configuration reference for the complete list of required files.

title: CDN
